title: themorevanillaarmor
description: 为我的世界增加了更多原版材料制作的盔甲。Adds more armor sets crafted from vanilla materials to Minecraft.
body:
This mod introduces additional armor sets crafted from vanilla materials to Minecraft, designed to provide players with a more interesting and smoother armor progression. The initial release features Wooden Armor, Cactus Armor, Coal Armor, Copper Armor, Redstone Armor, Lapis Lazuli Armor, Amethyst Armor, and Emerald Armor — each with unique full-set bonus effects. Full-set effects have also been added to vanilla armor sets for consistency and enhanced gameplay.
The following are the full-set effects for armors in the initial version. New armors and their full-set effects will be announced in update notes.
Full-Set Effects:

Mod-Added Armor

Wooden Armor — +1 Armor

Cactus Armor — Thorns

Coal Armor — Haste I

Copper Armor — +1 Armor

Redstone Armor — Regeneration I, Strength I

Lapis Lazuli Armor — Swiftness I, Water Breathing

Amethyst Armor — Night Vision

Emerald Armor — Resistance II, Damage Reduction (granted once per minute, max storage of 6)

Vanilla Armor

Leather Armor — +16 Toughness

Golden Armor — Haste II

Chainmail Armor — +4 Toughness

Iron Armor — +2 Armor

Diamond Armor — +3 Armor

Netherite Armor — +7 Armor, Resistance I, Fire Resistance

Disclaimer: This mod was created with AI assistance. Compatibility is not guaranteed. Please back up your saves before use.
